record.text: Wildfire smoke visible from the ridge above the valley this morning — evacuation advisory posted for the north side of town.

Unconfirmed reports of a new fire start near the reservoir trailhead.
Waiting on official confirmation before sharing more.
Shelter at the community center is open and taking evacuees, plenty of space and supplies as of right now.
Wind shift expected around 18:00 local — could push the fire line toward the eastern subdivision, residents should stay alert.
